items.name: Dahi
items.say: Darwaza kholte hi dahi ki baarish! Poora darwaza safed, chipchipa.

items.name: Pyaaz
items.say: Sofa par ek bada pyaaz baitha hai, TV dekh raha hai aur ro raha hai. 😢

items.name: Dhaniya
items.say: Rasoi mein dhaniya ka jungle ug gaya hai. Chulha bhi nahi dikh raha!

items.name: Aata
items.say: Bistar par aate ka gadda. Aap let gaye, aur aata udd gaya. Achhoo!

items.name: Chai
items.say: Balcony mein chai ka fawwara. Upar tak chai udd rahi hai.

say: Memory Palace. Duniya ke sabse bade memory champions ki trick.
Aur iske liye aapko kuch nahi chahiye. Sirf apna ghar.
Haan. Aapka ghar aap aankhein band karke bhi chal sakte hain. Hai na?
Toh ghar hi almaari banegi. Har kamra ek daraaz.

steps.say: Yeh raha ek ghar. 5 spots, hamesha isi order mein: darwaza, baithak, rasoi, sone ka kamra, balcony.
Pehle chalna seekhte hain. Order mein tap kijiye, darwaze se balcony tak. 🚶

steps.no: Abhi nahi. Order yaad kijiye: darwaza, baithak, rasoi, sone ka kamra, balcony.

say: Aaj ki list ki har cheez ko ek spot par rakhenge. Pagal tarike se.

steps.no: Yeh spot nahi. Tasveer phir se dekhiye.

say: Ghar mein chaliye. Har spot par kya tha?

steps.no: Yeh nahi. Us spot ki pagal tasveer yaad kijiye.

steps.hi: Pehli baar mein poora palace! Aap natural hain. 🌟
steps.mid: Achha. Jo spot chhoota, uski tasveer aur pagal banaiye. 👏
steps.lo: Palace pehli baar mein mushkil lagta hai. Kal phir chalenge, aur aasaan hoga.
steps.homework: Aaj raat sone se pehle, aankhein band karke ghar ke 5 spots par chaliye. Har spot par aaj ki cheez dekhiye. Kal subah poochungi! 👋
